meta.source: measured from 6 reference PNGs in replica/screens (pixel sampling + edge scans)
meta.scale_assumption: screenshots are 2x Retina; logical px = raw px / 2 (validated: widget panel 1079 raw -> 540, compact pill 330 raw -> 165)
meta.rule: values tagged estimate are inferred, not directly measured; no assets copied
